title: Silver can be worn, and it burns

sections.heading: Vampires and werewolves
items: Silver no longer tears itself off you. You may wear a silver ring, circlet or cuirass if you choose to, and silver in your pack is left alone: it is not mailed to your mailbox any more.
Worn silver sears you. It takes a little health every couple of seconds, more the longer you keep it on and more for each piece you wear at once.
Keep it on for about twenty seconds and you burst into flames, which others can see, and the burning bites far harder than the searing did.
Taking the silver off stops the pain and puts the flames out at once.
Silver can kill you this way, and it is an ordinary death: the usual rules for being downed apply.
Staff are not exempt. A vampire or werewolf on the staff burns like anyone else.
